lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in vertical columns, with 4-5 primary nodes per column in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits, reducing to 2-3 nodes as the flank tapers toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots to form a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side of the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a very low density of internal spots; the surface is predominantly dark grey and lacks the high-contrast circular clusters observed on the lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; no major amputations or parasitic lesions are clearly discernible in the current resolution.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermicular pattern of high-luminance pixels is visible on the dorsal-lateral surface anterior to the gill slits, contrasting with the discrete spot morphology on the posterior body.
